stem:
Jyoti dissolves 5 spoons of salt in 250 mL of water. Devansh dissolves 2 spoons of salt in 250 mL of water. Both stir until all the salt dissolves.

Which comparison is correct?

options.text: Jyoti has more solute in the same amount of solvent, so her solution is more concentrated.
Devansh has less solute, so his solution is more concentrated.
Both solutions have the same concentration because both use 250 mL of water.
Jyoti's solution is more concentrated because her glass looks fuller.

teacher.key_rationale: Concentration compares solute amount to a fixed amount of solvent or solution. More salt in the same water makes a more concentrated solution. Equal solvent volume alone does not equalise concentration, and how full the glass looks is not the measure.
